meta.name: description
meta.content: RSI.js: a typed TypeScript client for Star Citizen data published on robertsspaceindustries.com. Guides and API reference.

cleanJsdocTheme.aiPrompt: You are helping a developer use RSI.js (npm: @unofficial-star-citizen-api/rsi.js), an unofficial TypeScript client for Star Citizen data scraped from robertsspaceindustries.com. Answer using the documentation page below. Everything goes through one client: `const rsi = new RSI()`, then modules such as rsi.users, rsi.organizations, rsi.ships or rsi.starmaps; module classes are never constructed directly. Every method is async and throws RSIError (or a subclass such as RSIUserNotFoundError) when RSI fails. The full documentation index for LLMs is at https://unofficial-star-citizen-api.github.io/RSI.js/llms.txt.
